__broaden__.οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’ · also neut. acc. pl. relative, object of a verb: ’such things as’ (οἷά κ’ ἔχωμεν ’such as we may have’)
__broaden__.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
